item.title: Peoria man ordered held in custody in connection with 2024 deadly shooting
item.description: Mickael Williams, 27, has been charged with first-degree murder in connection with the Jan. 4, 2024, death of Arlin Bermudez Castellon, 34, and is being held pending the outcome of his case.

item.title: Illinois bill could affect proposed Pekin data center
item.description: A proposed state bill in Illinois could require data centers to pay for any increased utility costs caused by their operations, as well as build renewable energy and guarantee transparent public engagement.

item.title: Three DUI arrests made during East Peoria Police Department weekend enforcement
item.description: The East Peoria Police Department made 3 DUI arrests, 18 seatbelt citations, 5 child restraint citations, 5 speeding citations, 2 distracted driving citations, and 26 other citations during the Big Game enforcement effort last weekend.

item.title: Metamora teacher honored as teacher of the year for the region
item.description: Erinn Setterlund-Ambrosch, a Spanish teacher at Metamora Township High School, has been named West Central Regional Teacher of the Year by the Illinois State Board of Education for her cultural education and engagement with her students.

item.title: Normal teacher recognized as East Central Teacher of the Year
item.description: Don Whitman, an engineering and technology teacher at Normal Community High School, has been named East Central Teacher of the Year and is one of 13 teachers being considered for Illinois Teacher of the Year.

item.title: Richwood's basketball coach resigned after alleged inappropriate conduct
item.description: Ronald Ruffin, the assistant coach of the Richwoods High School girls basketball team, has resigned following allegations of "inappropriate conduct", and the school district is continuing to investigate the allegations and provide counseling to students and families.

item.title: Sideline Stories | Ep. 23: Patrick Cunningham & Jonathan Michel answer 6 questions for HS girls hoops playoffs
item.description: Patrick Cunningham and Jonathan Michel discuss six questions concerning high school girls' basketball in Central Illinois as the playoffs approach in this week's episode of Sideline Stories.

item.title: The ethanol fueled fight to stop higher gas prices
item.description: If no federal changes are made, gas prices in Illinois could increase by 30 cents per gallon in April, unless the state opts into the E-10 waiver program or Rep. Darin LaHood's bill allowing the sale of E-15 all year round is passed.
